submittedParameters.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Create ONE native transparent RGBA game animation frame, run east E09 compression.
Input1 is the ONLY edit target: the brown-haired golden thunder boy. Keep its head, face, hair, body, arms, hands, staff, plaque, costume and full-canvas size/position unchanged. Inputs2/3 are his authoritative identity and east idle. Input4 is approved painting style. Input5 silver-haired girl's E10 is ONLY a biomechanical pose guide for foot/ankle direction, never her identity/outfit/proportions.
Edit ONLY the boy's two legs below the hips so both knees, ankles and shoe long axes follow his eastward running sagittal plane. His shoe toes must point screen RIGHT in a crisp TRUE SIDE VIEW, just like input5. Do not leave the rear shoe turned toward camera: replace its broad front-facing oval toe with the outer SIDE PROFILE, heel left and toe downward-right as the heel recovers under the rump. The rear leg folds back, knee points forward along the track, not outward toward viewer. The planted front FAR LEFT shoe also must be a long side-profile shoe pointing RIGHT, not a front/three-quarter toe bulb. Keep white crossed shin wraps and original black/gold boot design. Narrow track under the hips, no splayed knees or duck feet. Exactly two continuous legs.
Retain COMPRESSION: the front left knee deeply flexes while supporting body weight; planted sole horizontal at y=.941 of the canvas, only redraw ankle and knee if needed, do NOT shift whole character to achieve this. Back right boot remains airborne. Maintain the exact old compression head top and head size; do not raise or enlarge him.
Retain anatomical RIGHT hand original gold thunder wand forward to right, LEFT hand rigid golden yin-yang rectangular plaque back to left, with original arm positions and two proper grips. Face pure east.
Bright detailed painted Q-style, huge round child head and short legs. Genuine alpha transparent background. No ground, shadow, effects, text, grid, copies or extra limb. At least 1280 square native single-frame composition. Visual target GPT Image 2.5 Sunburst/max; host model/quality selector unavailable.
